steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application name 'Notes Master' and package name 'com.notesmaster.app' for configuration mapping.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle
steps.description: Setup project dependencies, Android SDK target 34, min SDK 21, compilation options and namespaces using AGP 8.3.2 standards.

steps.title: Define App Permissions and Activity Registry
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with proper package mappings, application labels, icons, launch activities, and Material Light system theme.

steps.title: Create Database Helper Schema
steps.description: Design the DatabaseHelper SQLiteOpenHelper to manage persistent database table initialization for storing, querying, updating, and deleting note objects.

steps.title: Create Note Data Model
steps.description: Develop the pure Note Java model containing unique IDs, titles, descriptions, specific tags, and updated timestamps.

steps.title: Design Card Background Shape Drawables
steps.description: Create standard XML shape styles for note cards featuring custom rounded corners and bordered surfaces.

steps.title: Design Tag Background Shape Drawables
steps.description: Establish XML shapes for custom category tag indicators on note items.

steps.title: Design Floating Action Button Shape Drawables
steps.description: Implement rounded layout backgrounds mimicking circular FAB elements using vanilla XML custom shape styles.

steps.title: Design Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Build the activity_main layout using standard SDK components including headers, real-time search editbox, category filters spinner, and the add note FAB.

steps.title: Create Custom List Item Row Layout
steps.description: Develop custom note item layout to display individual title fields, categories, description snippets, date formatting, edit triggers, and delete buttons.

steps.title: Design Note Dialog Interface Layout
steps.description: Establish dialog layout elements configuration including edit input textboxes for title, note content, category drop-down selector, and custom actions control panel.

steps.title: Build Main Activity Dashboard Flow
steps.description: Initialize database records access, wire dynamic Search TextWatcher, establish Category Spinner adapter bindings, and handle active lists layout update.

steps.title: Implement Custom Note List Adapter
steps.description: Create custom notes BaseAdapter mapping dataset rows to specific template XML views and configuring single item actions listeners.

steps.title: Add Interactive Dialog Flow Logic
steps.description: Implement unified dialog workflow in MainActivity for adding new records or editing selected existing entries containing user inputs verification logic.

steps.title: Incorporate SQLite Update & Insertion Queries
steps.description: Configure SQLite database writing processes using ContentValues for reliable transactional insertions and updating queries.

steps.title: Implement Item Deletion and Safety Checks
steps.description: Provide confirmation alerts before database entry removals, refreshing data displays upon success.

steps.title: Establish Real-Time Search & Category Filters
steps.description: Write filter calculations using standard loops for instant text and tag modifications without needing thread interruptions.

steps.title: Building Notes Master
steps.description: Perform full app compilation using Gradle 8.5, target SDK 34, verifying proper rendering and full functionality compatibility.
